name: OpenRouter
author: SpoilHeap
description: Remaining OpenRouter credit in the bar, with purchased-versus-spent, key caps, and today/week/month spend in a popup.

barWidget.description: Credit remaining on the OpenRouter account, the spend behind it, and any cap on the key itself.

schema.label: Low balance warning
schema.description: Turn the bar figure urgent at or below this many credits remaining.

schema.label: Bar label
schema.description: Show the remaining figure next to the icon, or keep the bar to the icon alone.

schema.label: API key command
schema.description: Optional shell command that prints the OpenRouter key, e.g. 'pass show openrouter/api-key'. Leave empty to use OPENROUTER_API_KEY or ~/.config/omarchy/openrouter/key.
